answer_1.quote: In this paper, we address question answering (QA) due to its proximity to users in real-life settings, for instance, in the context of personal assistants.

answer_2.quote: In most recent works, evaluation of XQA models focuses on optimizing F1-scores of answers and explanations...

answer_4.quote: To investigate the relation between different evaluation scores and user experience, we conduct a user study.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to rate whether the model answer is correct and provide self-reports on certainty, completeness, helpfulness, trust, and satisfaction.
